provenance.th06: Classic TH06 v1.02h source art with separate alpha mask combined. TH06NC native radii separately checked equal; this catalog does not reproduce NC HD textures.
provenance.th18: TH18 v1.00a native ordinary-flight art, selected after ANM interruptLabel(2); spawn/disappearance frames excluded.

presentation_limits: Single ordinary-flight frame only; no native ANM animation, pulsing, spinning, anchor offsets or blend-mode reproduction.
TH06 FIREBALL slots 0..3 address four initial frames of one animation, not four palette colors; subsequent frame overwrites are omitted.
TH18 Fireball and Note types use their first ordinary animation frame. Their native color input is ignored, so all 16 logical colors share that frame.
Source pixels are copied 1:1 and centered in 64-pixel cells. Missing native palette slots stay invalid and transparent.
